patch_description: The current program uses a single Dirichlet seed with blind random hill-climbing (0.49 score). Key improvements: (1) multi-start with several diverse structured seeds (symmetric layers, hexagonal perturbation, boundary+rings, multiple Dirichlet samples with different fixed seeds), (2) targeted moves that push vertices of the currently-smallest triangle away from its centroid, which is far more sample-efficient than blind perturbation, (3) a time budget (~8s) split across seeds with soft (targeted) and hard (random) phases, and (4) keeping the best configuration across all restarts. The triplets are precomputed once and areas computed fully vectorized, which makes each evaluation cheap (165 triplets).
